description: Convert text to outlines (irreversible except via undo). Text frames that cannot be converted (e.g. locked) are left as-is and listed in "failed" with the reason; success is false if any failed. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

target.description: Target: "selection" (selected), "all" (all text), or a top-level layer name (includes text inside groups and sublayers; if several layers share the name, the topmost one is used and a warning is returned)

name: convert_to_outlines
title: Convert to Outlines
